metadata.model_name: Cointegration / Kalman-filter pairs strategy (profile v33, no learned ranker)
metadata.strategy_description: Cointegration / Kalman-filter pairs trading (study profile v33): Engle-Granger selection of same-industry pairs among the 500 most liquid of point-in-time Russell 3000 members (IWV N-PORT holdings), with a full re-selection every 126 trading days, a two-state Kalman hedge ratio locked at entry, z-score mean-reversion entries and exits, t+1 fills and daily mark-to-market accounting. Same-day candidate entries are ranked by signal strength times pair quality; no learned model is used. This is not a transformer trading model and not reinforcement learning.
metadata.file_name_note: The file name is historical and kept for backward compatibility; see backtest_period for the actual period.

field_notes.net_pnl_pct_of_equity: trade P&L after all costs, as % of PORTFOLIO equity at entry
field_notes.gross_pnl_pct_of_equity: trade P&L before costs, as % of portfolio equity at entry
field_notes.spread_return_pct: gross P&L per $ of GROSS NOTIONAL of the two legs, in %
field_notes.position_pct_of_equity: gross notional of both legs as % of portfolio equity at entry
field_notes.holding_days_calendar: calendar days from the entry fill to the exit fill
field_notes.trading_days_held: trading days from the entry fill to the exit fill
field_notes.drawdowns: all drawdown fields are <= 0, relative to the running peak; the starting capital counts as the first peak
field_notes.profit_factor: sum of winning trades / |sum of losing trades|; null when there is no losing trade (infinite) or no trade at all
field_notes.dates: YYYY-MM-DD exchange-local trading dates; null where no real date exists

config.scheme: rolling 12m formation / 6m trading (Gatev et al. 2006); prices re-normalised at each block start; exit at the next crossing
config.fill: t+1 close (signal on the day-t close)
config.cost_basis: pipeline cost model: commission + half-spread + sqrt impact per leg execution (own ADV/vol), borrow on the short leg, financing on gross
config.return_basis: committed capital: pair P&L / per-leg notional, equal-weighted over the nominated pairs (idle pairs earn 0)

distance_same_bar_fills.note: fills at the signal close (no one-day wait): captures bid-ask bounce; NOT comparable to the t+1 pipeline

factor_attribution.market_proxy: equal-weight daily return of 11 sector SPDR ETFs
